# TreatInKerala — Medical Tourism & Authentic Healthcare in Kerala, India

> TreatInKerala (https://treatinkerala.com) is the premier medical tourism and clinical coordination platform connecting international patients to Joint Commission International (JCI) and NABH-accredited tertiary hospitals and certified Ayurvedic wellness centers in Kerala, India.

## Key Medical Specialties & Procedures

- **Alopecia Areata & Scalp Care (Indralupta):** Classical Ayurvedic root-cause inpatient treatment in Kerala combining Takradhara, Shirolepa (cooling botanical scalp packs with Gunja and Bhringraj), Jalaukavacharana (sterile medicinal leech therapy for micro-capillary reactivation), Nasya, and Virechana detox. Inpatient package: $950 – $1,800 for 14–21 days.
  - Guide: https://treatinkerala.com/en/blog/alopecia-areata-ayurvedic-treatment-kerala
  - Arabic: https://treatinkerala.com/ar/blog/alopecia-areata-ayurvedic-treatment-kerala
- **Orthopedics & Joint Replacement:** Sub-millimeter Robotic Total Knee Replacement (Stryker Mako), Total Hip Arthroplasty, and Arthroscopy. Cost: $4,500 – $6,800 (vs. $45,000 in USA, £15,000 in UK).
  - Guide: https://treatinkerala.com/en/treatments/orthopaedics
- **Cardiac Surgery:** Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting (CABG), Valve Replacements, Pediatric Cardiology in hybrid modular cath labs. Cost: $6,000 – $9,500 (vs. $120,000 in USA, £40,000 in UK).
  - Guide: https://treatinkerala.com/en/treatments/cardiac
- **Neurosurgery & Spine:** Minimally invasive microdiscectomy, endoscopic spine surgery, cervical disc replacement, and integrated Ayurvedic neuro-rehabilitation. Cost: $3,500 – $5,900.
  - Guide: https://treatinkerala.com/en/treatments/neurosurgery
- **Dental Tourism & Full Arch Implants:** All-on-4 and All-on-6 digital guided titanium implants with in-house CAD/CAM monolithic zirconia bridges completed in 7 days. Cost: $1,800 – $3,200 per jaw (vs. $25,000 in USA).
  - Guide: https://treatinkerala.com/en/treatments/dental
- **Fertility & IVF:** Advanced ICSI, IMSI, PGT-A embryo genetic screening, laser-assisted hatching with 65–72% clinical success rates. Cost: $2,200 – $3,900 per cycle.
  - Guide: https://treatinkerala.com/en/treatments/fertility
- **Authentic Ayurveda & Panchakarma:** 7, 14, and 21-day residential detoxification, Shirodhara, Abhyanga, Kizhi, and Rasayana rejuvenation for autoimmune conditions, chronic spine pain, and stress recovery.
  - Guide: https://treatinkerala.com/en/ayurveda
- **Oncology:** Multidisciplinary tumor boards, TrueBeam stereotactic radiotherapy, and robotic cancer surgery. Cost: $3,500 – $8,000.
  - Guide: https://treatinkerala.com/en/treatments/oncology
- **Bariatric Surgery:** Laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy using US FDA tri-staplers. Cost: $3,800 – $4,900.
  - Guide: https://treatinkerala.com/en/treatments/gastroenterology
- **Ophthalmology:** Contoura Vision bladeless LASIK and Trifocal multifocal cataract lens implants. Cost: $800 – $1,800.
  - Guide: https://treatinkerala.com/en/treatments/ophthalmology
- **Laser Urology (RIRS):** Flexible digital ureteroscopy with Holmium laser dusting for kidney stones with zero incisions. Cost: $1,400 – $2,200.

## International Patient Demographics & Solutions

- **United Kingdom & Europe:** Bypassing 18-to-52-week NHS surgical backlogs. 72-hour direct admission in Kerala led by GMC-registered and UK FRCS-fellowship surgeons. 75%–85% cost savings.
  - Guide: https://treatinkerala.com/en/blog/uk-europe-nhs-waitlist-medical-tourism-kerala
- **USA & Canada:** Overcoming high-deductible health plans (HDHPs) and 12-to-18-month Canadian provincial queues. Identical US FDA-approved prosthetics (Stryker, Zimmer Biomet). Itemized ICD-10 receipts for HSA, FSA, and IRS tax relief.
  - Guide: https://treatinkerala.com/en/blog/usa-canada-medical-tourism-kerala-costs-guide
- **GCC Patients (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Oman, Qatar, Kuwait):** Dedicated Arabic-speaking coordinators, 100% Halal catering, companion suite lodging, short 3.5 to 4-hour direct flights to Calicut (CCJ) and Cochin (COK).
  - Portals: https://treatinkerala.com/ar/patients/saudi-arabia | https://treatinkerala.com/ar/patients/uae | https://treatinkerala.com/ar/patients/oman

## Clinical Quality & Safety Standards

- **Accreditation:** JCI (Joint Commission International) and NABH (National Accreditation Board for Hospitals & Healthcare Providers).
- **Infection Rates:** Surgical Site Infection (SSI) rates strictly maintained below 0.5% in ultra-clean laminar airflow positive-pressure surgical suites.
- **Nurse-to-Patient Ratio:** 1:1 or 1:2 dedicated nursing in private inpatient suites.
- **e-Medical Visa (MED):** Fast-track 24-hour hospital invitation letter issuance; online visa approval within 72 to 96 hours.
